label: Survey Site Type (IRI)
rdfs_comment: A spatial category of a sampling location for an eco:Survey.
dcterms_description: Terms in the dwciri: namespace are intended to be used in RDF with non-literal objects.

label: Compilation Source Types
rdfs_comment: The type of data source contributing to the compilation reported.
dcterms_description: This term is only relevant if the eco:Survey is a compilation in which one or more types of data sources were used. Terms in the ecoiri: namespace are intended to be used in RDF with non-literal objects.

label: Compilation Types
rdfs_comment: A statement specifying whether data reported are derived from sampling events, ancillary data compiled from other sources, or a combination of both.
dcterms_description: This term is only relevant if the eco:Survey is an inventory. Recommended best practice is to use an IRI from a controlled vocabulary. Terms in the ecoiri: namespace are intended to be used in RDF with non-literal objects.

label: Material Sample Types
rdfs_comment: A material sample type collected during the eco:Survey.
dcterms_description: Recommended best practice is to use an IRI from a controlled vocabulary. Terms in the ecoiri: namespace are intended to be used in RDF with non-literal objects.

label: Excluded Habitat Scope
rdfs_comment: The habitat explicitly excluded from sampling during an eco:Survey.
dcterms_description: Recommended best practice is to use an IRI from a controlled vocabulary. Terms in the ecoiri: namespace are intended to be used in RDF with non-literal objects.

label: Target Habitat Scope
rdfs_comment: The habitat targeted for sampling during an eco:Survey.
dcterms_description: Recommended best practice is to use an IRI from a controlled vocabulary. Terms in the ecoiri: namespace are intended to be used in RDF with non-literal objects.

label: Target Growth Form Scope
rdfs_comment: The growth form or habit of the dwc:Organisms targeted for sampling during the eco:Survey.
dcterms_description: Recommended best practice is to use an IRI from a controlled vocabulary. Terms in the ecoiri: namespace are intended to be used in RDF with non-literal objects.

label: Excluded Growth Form Scope
rdfs_comment: The growth form or habit of the dwc:Organisms explicitly excluded from sampling during an eco:Survey.
dcterms_description: Recommended best practice is to use an IRI from a controlled vocabulary. Terms in the ecoiri: namespace are intended to be used in RDF with non-literal objects.

label: Excluded Degree of Establishment Scope
rdfs_comment: The degree of establishment of the dwc:Organisms explicitly excluded from sampling during an eco:Survey.
dcterms_description: Recommended best practice is to use an IRI from the controlled vocabulary designated for use with this term, listed at http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/doc/doe/. For details, refer to https://doi.org/10.3897/biss.3.38084 . Terms in the ecoiri: namespace are intended to be used in RDF with non-literal objects.

label: Target Degree of Establishment Scope
rdfs_comment: The degree of establishment of the dwc:Organisms targeted for sampling during an eco:Survey.
dcterms_description: Recommended best practice is to use an IRI from the controlled vocabulary designated for use with this term, listed at http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/doc/doe/. For details, refer to https://doi.org/10.3897/biss.3.38084 . Terms in the ecoiri: namespace are intended to be used in RDF with non-literal objects.

label: Excluded Life Stage Scope
rdfs_comment: The age class or life stage of the dwc:Organisms explicitly excluded from sampling during an eco:Survey.
dcterms_description: This term is defined based on dwciri:lifeStage (http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/iri/lifeStage). Recommended best practice is to use an IRI from the same controlled vocabulary as for dwciri:lifeStage. Terms in the ecoiri: namespace are intended to be used in RDF with non-literal objects.

label: Target Life Stage Scope
rdfs_comment: The age class or life stage of the dwc:Organisms targeted for sampling during an eco:Survey.
dcterms_description: This term is defined based on dwciri:lifeStage (http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/iri/lifeStage). Recommended best practice is to use an IRI from the same controlled vocabulary as for dwciri:lifeStage. Terms in the ecoiri: namespace are intended to be used in RDF with non-literal objects.

label: Non-target Taxa
rdfs_comment: A taxon reported during the eco:Survey that is outside of the target taxonomic scope (the combination of ecoiri:targetTaxonomicScope and ecoiri:excludedTaxonomicScope).
dcterms_description: This term is meant to allow a taxon that is considered outside of the taxonomic scope and yet was reported in the dataset to be shared. This term is relevant only if a target taxonomic scope is declared and eco:hasNonTargetTaxa is ‘true’. Taxonomic scope is based on the combination of ecoiri:targetTaxonomicScope and ecoiri:excludedTaxonomicScope. Non-target taxa (in some disciplines called “bycatch”) can be reported at any taxonomic level. Terms in the ecoiri: namespace are intended to be used in RDF with non-literal objects.

label: Taxon Completeness Protocols
rdfs_comment: A method or protocol used to determine ecoiri:taxonCompletenessReported, denoted by an IRI.
dcterms_description: This term allows users to determine how comprehensively an area has been sampled. Terms in the ecoiri: namespace are intended to be used in RDF with non-literal objects.

label: Taxon Completeness Reported
rdfs_comment: Statement about whether the taxonomic completeness of an eco:Survey was assessed.
dcterms_description: This term is meant to alert users that the inventory was conducted in such a way that all of the target taxa (the combination of ecoiri:targetTaxonomicScope and ecoiri:excludedTaxonomicScope) should have been detectable if they were present during the eco:Survey. This term can provide data users with a qualitative measure of how comprehensively an area has been surveyed, which assists in interpreting species populations, areas of occupancy, inferring species absences, etc. This term is only relevant if the eco:Survey used restricted search or open search methods. If taxonomic completeness was assessed, the methods used or an explanation of the basis of the completeness should be covered by ecoiri:taxonCompletenessProtocols. Recommended best practice is to use an IRI from the controlled vocabulary designated for use with this term, listed at http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/doc/tcr/. Terms in the ecoiri: namespace are intended to be used in RDF with non-literal objects.

label: Excluded Taxonomic Scope
rdfs_comment: The taxonomic group explicitly excluded from sampling during an eco:Survey.
dcterms_description: The eco:Survey to which the ecoiri:excludedTaxonomicScope refers could be at any level of hierarchy. In the case of a higher level (parent) eco:Survey, include all the taxonomic groups explicitly excluded from the child eco:Surveys that contributed to the parent eco:Survey. Terms in the ecoiri: namespace are intended to be used in RDF with non-literal objects.

label: Target Taxonomic Scope
rdfs_comment: The taxonomic group targeted for sampling during an eco:Survey.
dcterms_description: The eco:Survey to which the ecoiri:targetTaxonomicScope refers could be at any level of hierarchy. In the case of a higher level (parent) eco:Survey, include all taxonomic groups surveyed in the child eco:Surveys that contributed to the parent eco:Survey. Terms in the ecoiri: namespace are intended to be used in RDF with non-literal objects.

label: Absent Taxa
rdfs_comment: A taxon reported absent during an eco:Survey.
dcterms_description: Absences can be reported at any taxonomic level. Terms in the ecoiri: namespace are intended to be used in RDF with non-literal objects.

label: Inventory Types
rdfs_comment: The type of search process used to conduct an eco:Survey.
dcterms_description: This term is only relevant if the eco:Survey represents an inventory. Recommended best practice is to use an IRI from a controlled vocabulary. Terms in the ecoiri: namespace are intended to be used in RDF with non-literal objects.

label: Geospatial Scope Area Unit
rdfs_comment: The units associated with eco:geospatialScopeAreaValue.
dcterms_description: Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary. Terms in the dwciri: namespace are intended to be used in RDF with non-literal objects.

label: Sampling Performed By
rdfs_comment: A person, group, or organization responsible for recording an eco:Survey.
dcterms_description: An eco:Survey could be at any level of hierarchy. In the case of a higher level (parent) eco:Survey, include all the organizations or people involved in the child eco:Surveys that contributed to the parent eco:Survey. Terms in the ecoiri: namespace are intended to be used in RDF with non-literal objects.

label: Sampling Effort Unit
rdfs_comment: The units associated with an eco:samplingEffortValue.
dcterms_description: Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary. Terms in the dwciri: namespace are intended to be used in RDF with non-literal objects.

label: Protocol Names
rdfs_comment: An IRI identifying a categorical descriptive name for the methods used during an eco:Survey.
dcterms_description: Recommended best practice is to use an IRI from a controlled vocabulary. Terms in the ecoiri: namespace are intended to be used in RDF with non-literal objects.

label: Total Area Sampled Unit
rdfs_comment: The units associated with eco:totalAreaSampledValue
dcterms_description: Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary. Terms in the dwciri: namespace are intended to be used in RDF with non-literal objects.
